g1-implement.title: Scoring primitives + report schema: implement
g1-implement.imperative: Fill IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF for g1. Build the pure, dependency-light core of the trajectory grading harness in a new submodule src/preprocessing/trajectory_grading/ (no fastf1/DB IO in this gate — operate on plain numpy/dataclass inputs). Deliver: (1) a candidate-trajectory contract (s(t) samples + covariance + arc-length and integrated-speed accessors) as a dataclass/Protocol; (2) the SECTOR-ANCHOR GATE primitive: given a candidate s(t) and official per-sector split times across laps, CO-ESTIMATE the per-circuit sector-loop arc-length anchor positions (free parameters with reported uncertainty) and return predicted-vs-official sector-crossing residuals + a pass/fail at a configurable tolerance (default 50ms); anchors are NEVER hard-coded; (3) the COVARIANCE-CONSISTENCY GATE primitive: reduced chi-square of residuals against the candidate's reported covariance, pass/fail near 1 within a configurable band; (4) the CROSS-RESIDUAL DIAGNOSTIC primitive (NOT a gate): fit a per-lap inter-stream time offset as a free parameter, compare integrated-speed arc length vs position-derived arc length with lap closure, return fitted offsets + arc-length residuals; (5) the JSON report schema as frozen dataclasses with a to_dict/serializer, plus docs/report_schemas/trajectory_grading_report.md documenting it (producer + doc together). Truth-anchored unit tests (L1/L2): synthetic candidate with KNOWN anchors/offset recovers them; white-noise residuals give reduced chi-square approx 1; degenerate/limit cases (L3). Validate inputs naming field/expectation/actual. Run py -m src.utils.simplification_limits on touched paths.

postconditions.statement: IMPLEMENTER_RESULT returned with no unresolved blockers

constraints: Physics region only: no imports from src/evo_predictor, src/latent_power, src/compound_prior.
No fastf1 or DB IO in this gate (pure scoring core + schema).
Anchor sector-loop positions are calibration parameters with uncertainty, never hard-coded constants.
Cross-residual is a diagnostic, never a gate.
Physics evidence bar: truth-anchored L1-L4 tests; units, bounds, invariants explicit.
Committed report schema needs producer + docs/report_schemas doc together.
py not python; tests via py -m pytest.

g2-implement.title: Offline loaders + strawman candidate + runner: implement
g2-implement.imperative: Fill IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF for g2. Add the IO + wiring layer in src/preprocessing/trajectory_grading/: (1) an offline raw-stream loader using fastf1.Cache.enable_cache on the absolute cache path (read raw session.car_data[driver]/session.pos_data[driver] ONLY; NEVER get_telemetry except inside the strawman); (2) a DB truth loader for per-sector split times via src/data/database DatabaseManager (the season DBs at the absolute data path); (3) the STRAWMAN candidate: deliberately wrap FastF1's merged lap.get_telemetry() product as a candidate trajectory (the artifact under study) implementing the candidate contract from g1, deriving s(t) and a (deliberately naive) covariance; (4) a runner that, given (year, gp, session, drivers), builds the strawman candidate, loads truth, runs all three g1 primitives, and writes the g1 JSON report to disk. Integration test on ONE small session (load offline -> score -> assert report shape + that gate verdicts are produced). Pass utf-8 in any captured subprocess env. Run simplification_limits on touched paths.

g3-implement.title: Multi-session strawman run + verdict: implement
g3-implement.imperative: Fill IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF for g3. Add a thin exploration driver under scripts/ that runs the g2 harness over >=3 cached sessions spanning 2022-2025 with >=1 race and >=1 quali (document the exact picks + why), writing one machine-readable JSON report per session to .agent-work/issue-446/evidence/ (NOT committed as bulky data). Then author the VERDICT: read the reports and write .agent-work/issue-446/VERDICT.md with the key numbers per session (strawman sector-anchor residuals + pass/fail at 50ms; reduced chi-square; fitted inter-stream offsets per lap/session) and the discrimination conclusion: does the harness separate the strawman's known pathologies, or is it an HONEST NULL at 50ms with unknown anchors (report with equal rigor). This run is foreground compute (no backgrounding); if a single session looks like >30 min checkpoint partials to disk. No new shipping src/ code in this gate beyond the scripts/ driver.
